The '''Black Sun blaster rifle''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used by [[Black Sun foot soldier/Legends|Black Sun foot soldiers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Like the [[Black Sun foot soldier blaster/Legends|Black Sun foot soldier blaster]], it featured two barrels.

==History==
During a [[Mission to Callos|mission]] to [[Callos]], some of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] leader [[T'orn Zorc]]'s [[Black Sun foot soldier/Legends|foot soldiers]] wielded these [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].
